# Gantt and Scheduler column headers clash with the timeline header surface

## Context

Engine 14 release blocker confirmed by `@tobiu` on `https://neomjs.com/dist/production/examples/gantt/basic/index.html` (and previously surfaced as an open question during `#21418` / session `5b452f4a`, memory `58772d7a`, without a ticket ever being filed): in Gantt and Scheduler views, the top-left resource/task column header cell (`Task`, `Studio`, etc., and additional locked/unlocked resource or task columns) paints in `Neo.grid.header.Button`'s standalone steel-blue (`#5d83a7` in `neo-theme-neo-light` and `neo-theme-light`) or deep purple (`var(--purple-900)` in `neo-theme-neo-dark`), clashing starkly with the adjacent `Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader` surface (`#e9edf2` / `#f2f2f2` / `#161c26`).

## The Problem

A Gantt chart or Scheduler has one continuous header bar (`Neo.grid.header.Toolbar`) split horizontally between its resource/task column headers (`Neo.grid.header.Button`) on the left and `Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader` on the right:

1. `TimeAxisHeader` uses `--neo-timeline-header-background` (`#e9edf2` in `neo-light`, `#f2f2f2` in `light`, `#161c26` in `neo-dark`, `var(--cyber-bg-alt)` in `cyberpunk`) and `--neo-timeline-header-color` (`#1f2937` / `#1f2933` / `#d6dce6`).
2. Meanwhile, `resources/css/src/scheduler/Container.css:3–8` and `resources/css/src/gantt/Container.css:87–91` only set `.neo-grid-header-button { height: 100%; }`, leaving every resource/task `Neo.grid.header.Button` on the raw data-grid palette (`resources/css/theme-neo-light/grid/header/Button.css:2` `#5d83a7` with white `#fff` text and `justify-content: flex-end`; `theme-light/grid/header/Button.css:2` `#5d83a7` with `justify-content: flex-end`; `theme-neo-dark/grid/header/Button.css:2` `var(--purple-900)` with hover `var(--purple-500)`).
3. As a result, unless an individual example manually overrides `.neo-grid-header-button` in its own `Viewport.css`, the top-left corner (`Task` in `gantt/basic`, `Studio` in `scheduler/basic`, etc.) renders as an alien steel-blue or purple block beside the neutral timeline header, and in `light` / `neo-light` right-aligns (`flex-end`) single-column labels unless overridden.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/scheduler/Container.css:3–8` & `resources/css/src/gantt/Container.css:87–91` (plus `resources/css/theme-{neo-light,neo-dark,light,dark,cyberpunk}/{scheduler,gantt}/Container.css` and `timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css`): own family-level header bar appearance for `Neo.scheduler.Container` (`.neo-scheduler`) and `Neo.gantt.Container` (`.neo-gantt`).
- Non-timeline column headers inside `.neo-scheduler` and `.neo-gantt` can be either non-sortable (`sortable: false` / `.neo-sort-hidden`) or sortable (e.g. `examples/scheduler/resourceColumns`, `examples/gantt/taskColumns` `#21655`). Sortable column headers still need a subtle, theme-coherent hover state derived from the timeline header palette rather than `#6d93b7` steel-blue or `--purple-500`, while non-sortable column headers (`sortable: false`) should not look like primary action buttons.
- Design authority: `@tobiu` Engine 14 visual release gate on `examples/gantt/basic` (`2026-11-19` memory `58772d7a` + `2026-11-21` escalation confirming the mismatched steel-blue top-left corner is a v14 release blocker).

## The Fix

1. Align `.neo-scheduler .neo-grid-header-toolbar .neo-grid-header-button:not(.neo-timeline-header)` and `.neo-gantt .neo-grid-header-toolbar .neo-grid-header-button:not(.neo-timeline-header)` (via `--grid-header-button-*` CSS custom property bindings in `resources/css/src/{scheduler,gantt}/Container.css` and theme tokens in `resources/css/theme-*/{scheduler,gantt}/Container.css` or `timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css` where needed) so that across all five themes (`neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-cyberpunk`):
   - Rest background, text color, glyph color, bottom border, and right/locked-region divider match `--neo-timeline-header-background`, `--neo-timeline-header-color`, and `--neo-timeline-border-color`.
   - Default horizontal alignment in Scheduler and Gantt resource/task headers is `flex-start` (while honoring `.neo-header-align-right` / `.neo-header-align-center` column alignment classes from `#21273`).
   - Hover state on sortable column headers uses a subtle neutral surface step coherent with `--neo-timeline-header-background` and high-contrast text (`>= 4.5:1` WCAG AA), never `#6d93b7` steel-blue or `--purple-500`.
2. Rebuild themes (`node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`) and verify `npm run check-theme-surfaces` + `check-theme-var-references.mjs`.
3. Add Playwright visual/computed-style assertions verifying that in `examples/gantt/basic` and `examples/scheduler/basic` across all five themes, the locked-start header button's rest background matches `.neo-timeline-header` and text contrast passes.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] In both `Neo.gantt.Container` (`examples/gantt/basic`) and `Neo.scheduler.Container` (`examples/scheduler/basic`), non-timeline column header buttons (`Task`, `Studio`, and multi-column locked/unlocked headers) share a cohesive header surface and border seam with `.neo-timeline-header` across all five shipped themes (`neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-cyberpunk`) — no `#5d83a7` steel-blue or `--purple-900` mismatch.
- [ ] Left-aligned default (`justify-content: flex-start`) applies to Gantt and Scheduler column headers in `light` and `neo-light` while preserving `.neo-header-align-right` and `.neo-header-align-center` overrides.
- [ ] Sortable column headers in Gantt and Scheduler retain a subtle, high-contrast (`>= 4.5:1`) hover state coherent with each theme's timeline header palette.
- [ ] Automated Playwright spec asserts header surface parity across all five themes, and PR includes before/after screenshots of `examples/gantt/basic` and `examples/scheduler/basic` in `neo-theme-neo-light` and `neo-theme-neo-dark`.

## Out of Scope

- Changing standalone `Neo.grid.Container` header colors outside `.neo-scheduler` and `.neo-gantt`.
- Neutralizing `TimeAxisHeader` whole-axis `:hover` (tracked in the sibling `TimeAxisHeader` hover ticket).

## Avoided Traps

- Putting selector rules inside `resources/css/theme-*/...` token-only files, which fails `check-theme-value-files.mjs`; keep selectors in `resources/css/src/...` and only `--*` token declarations in `resources/css/theme-*/...`.
- Overriding `justify-content` with high specificity that breaks `.neo-header-align-right` numeric columns in `gantt/taskColumns` or `scheduler/resourceColumns` — bind `--grid-header-button-justify-content: flex-start` instead!
